# langsmith_workspace (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_workspace" "example" {
  display_name  = "Demo Workspace"
  tenant_handle = "demo-workspace"
}

# The provider endpoint must be able to resolve the data plane in your organization.
# Creation goes through the selected data plane, which proxies to the control plane.
resource "langsmith_workspace" "byoc" {
  display_name  = "BYOC Workspace"
  data_plane_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Workspace display name.

### Optional

- `data_plane_id` (String) Data plane ID for workspace creation. The provider resolves its API URL through the configured endpoint and creates the workspace through that data plane. Omit to use the provider endpoint. Changing this value requires replacement.
- `id` (String) Workspace ID. Leave unset to let LangSmith generate one.
- `tenant_handle` (String) Workspace handle. LangSmith only accepts this on create.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `data_plane_url` (String) Workspace data plane URL when returned by the API.
- `is_deleted` (Boolean) Whether this workspace is deleted.
- `is_personal` (Boolean) Whether this is a personal workspace.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by workspace ID. Refresh discovers the data plane URL for updates/deletes.
terraform import langsmith_workspace.example workspace-id

# Include the data plane ID when data_plane_id is set in the resource configuration.
terraform import langsmith_workspace.byoc workspace-id/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
